verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a pre-built "ML in a Box" machine template with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers preinstalled, so PyTorch/CUDA-style environments are available out of the box. Custom templates are user-created snapshots, not pre-built images, and the DigitalOcean Marketplace 1-Click models target GPU Droplets rather than Paperspace, so neither is credited here. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch template naming, vLLM template, ComfyUI template, a broader catalog of pre-built templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Choose "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with all the major ML frameworks and CUDA® drivers.
When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template
